basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast hailing from Tucson, Arizona. By day, I work as a network administrator, ensuring that our systems run smoothly. In my free time, I love diving into the world of custom PC builds and exploring the latest in tech. I'm also passionate about sustainability, actively seeking ways to recycle and upcycle old tech. I've been married for 8 years and my spouse shares my love for technology. Typically, you'll find me online during late evenings, especially on weekdays.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Information Technology from the University of Arizona and have been working in the IT field for over a decade. My journey into tech started with building my first computer during college, which ignited a lifelong passion for DIY tech projects. I frequently attend local tech meetups and stay updated through online courses.
